$comment: Served-spec scope exclusions for tests/openapi-served-coverage.test.js. GET /openapi.json is generated from DISCOVERABILITY_ROUTES (server/discoverability.mjs), which is the curated in-scope MACHINE surface - not the full route table. Every served /api route template must either appear in the served spec or match one exclusion prefix below. Prefixes are matched against {}-normalized templates (see templateKey in scripts/route-docs-check.mjs). A new route that matches no prefix fails CI until it is inventoried or an exclusion is added with a reason. An exclusion prefix that matches nothing fails CI as stale.
